inputs.name: registerConsoleCommand.program
inputs.description: The commander Command that the `console` command is added to as a subcommand. The function uses it only for `program.command('console')` and does not check it first, so it must be a Command.

outputs.name: registerConsoleCommand
outputs.description: The `console` Command created by `program.command('console')`, not `program` itself. It is returned after the install, objects, uninstall and restore subcommands have been registered on it.
